messages:
alex: prod-ingress started routing a subset of enterprise traffic to enterprise-v2 after the ingress rewrite -> spike in 502s around 02:10 UTC. I think the header match got looser. putting a hotfix plan here.
ben: saw ~320 502s in last 5m, most from ent-* tenants. Agree this is header matching fallout. We should short-circuit.
priya: oncall here. opening an incident page and paging SRE. Can we add a temporary header override to force old route? e.g. inject X-RW-Route: enterprise-v1 at the gateway until we patch.
jamie: yes. quick safe override instead of full rollback. Proposed one-liner patch below — will PR if folks agree.

```yaml
# current (buggy)
match:
  - header: "x-rw-tenant"
    prefix: "ent-"
then:
  route: enterprise-v2

# temp override (force legacy for ambiguous matches)
match:
  - header: "x-rw-tenant"
    prefix: "ent-"
    not_in: "ent-safe-list"
then:
  set_header: { "x-rw-route": "enterprise-v1" }
```

deploy-bot: deploy request queued by jamie at 2140001245, job deploy-8921. rolling to edge-pool-3.
srep-bot: incident INC-2026-58 created, severity P1. paging rotation notified.
pat: applied patch to edge nodes, toggled override. initial telemetry: ingress->routes->enterprise errors down from 320->18 in 4m, latency dropping. holding for 10m then will expand.
maria: add a short-term throttle on enterprise-v2 (5rps per tenant) while we validate; also adding a dashboard row: ingress.route.override.count and route-mismatch-rate.
ben: please add alert: route-mismatch-rate > 0.5% for 2m -> page eng-runtime.
priya: ack. I’ll own postmortem if we declare incident. If stable after 30m we close and ship a proper fix that tightens matching semantics.
alex: rollback checklist if override causes issues: 1) revert override header patch 2) flip routing precedence to legacy-first 3) emergency pin to legacy-cluster and reroute via traffic-shunt. postmortem owner: priya. thanks all :thumbsup:
ben: small nit — add telemetry tag "hotfix=header-override" so cost/latency fragments are tracked.
pat: done. logs show tag present in traces.
jamie: PR opened with tests and a canary; will coordinate formal deploy tomorrow. closing thread for now, monitoring in #oncall-ops.
